info.title: Church Member Management API
info.description: API documentation for the Church Member Management System. Covers geographic data (provinces, districts, sectors, cellules, villages) and member management.

post.description: Authenticates a user with their email and password and returns a bearer token to use for subsequent authenticated requests.
Revokes the bearer token used to authenticate the current request.
Sends a password reset token by email if an account exists for the given address. Always responds with a generic message so callers can't use it to discover which emails are registered.

message.example: If an account with that email exists, a password reset link has been sent.

post.description: Resets a user's password using the token they received by email. Revokes all of the user's existing bearer tokens.

message.example: Your password has been reset successfully.

422.description: Invalid/expired token, unknown user, or validation error

message.example: This password reset token is invalid.

get.description: Returns all cellules belonging to the specified sector, ordered alphabetically.

get.description: Returns a paginated collection of all families ordered by family name, together with their members.

post.description: Creates a new family, optionally assigning members and the role each plays (father, mother, child, guardian). A family may have at most one active father and one active mother at a time.

members.description: Members to assign to this family, each paired with the role they play

message.example: The family name field is required.

family_name: The family name field is required.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific family by its ID, including its members and their roles.

put.description: Updates a family record. All fields are optional. Passing `members` replaces the existing member/role assignments entirely.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the family to update

members.description: Replaces the members assigned to this family, each paired with the role they play

message.example: This family already has an active father.

members: This family already has an active father.

delete.description: Deletes a family record. Membership rows for this family are removed via cascading delete.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the family to delete

post.summary: Add a member to a family
post.description: Assigns a member to a family with a given role. Rejects a second active (no end_date) father or mother for the same family.

message.example: This family already has an active father.

members: This family already has an active father.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a family
delete.description: Removes all role assignments a member holds within the given family.

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: The ID of the member to remove

post.description: Creates a new church member record. Returns the created member. Submitted as multipart/form-data to support the optional picture upload.

talent.description: IDs of talents selected (at least one required). Submitted as multipart/form-data: use repeated fields (talent[]=1&talent[]=2), a single JSON-encoded string (e.g. "[1,2]"), a comma-separated string (e.g. "1,2"), or a bare single ID (e.g. talent=1).

spiritual_gift.description: IDs of spiritual gifts selected (at least one required). Submitted as multipart/form-data: use repeated fields (spiritual_gift[]=1&spiritual_gift[]=3), a single JSON-encoded string (e.g. "[1,3]"), a comma-separated string (e.g. "1,3"), or a bare single ID (e.g. spiritual_gift=1).

employed.description: Submitted as multipart/form-data as the literal string "true" or "false" (also accepts "1"/"0").

occupation.description: IDs of occupations selected. Submitted as multipart/form-data: use repeated fields (occupation[]=2), a single JSON-encoded string (e.g. "[2]"), a comma-separated string (e.g. "2,4"), or a bare single ID (e.g. occupation=2).

education.description: Education levels selected, each paired with its own faculty IDs. This is an array of objects, which cannot be expressed as a plain multipart/form-data field — submit it as a single JSON-encoded string, e.g. [{"education_id":3,"faculty":[4,5]}].

department.description: Departments selected, each paired with its own church responsibility IDs. This is an array of objects, which cannot be expressed as a plain multipart/form-data field — submit it as a single JSON-encoded string, e.g. [{"department_id":1,"church_responsibility":[1,2]}].

picture.description: Image file (jpeg, jpg, png, webp), max 2MB

message.example: The first name field is required.

first_name: The first name field is required.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific church member by their ID.

put.description: Updates a church member record. All fields are optional (PATCH behaviour). Returns the updated member. Passing a new `picture` replaces and deletes the previous one; omitting it leaves the current picture untouched. Submitted as multipart/form-data to support the picture upload — since PHP does not parse multipart bodies on PUT requests, send this as a POST with a `_method=PUT` field (Laravel's standard method-spoofing).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the member to update

talent.description: IDs of talents selected (at least one required if provided). Submitted as multipart/form-data: use repeated fields (talent[]=1&talent[]=2), a single JSON-encoded string (e.g. "[1,2]"), a comma-separated string (e.g. "1,2"), or a bare single ID (e.g. talent=1).

spiritual_gift.description: IDs of spiritual gifts selected (at least one required if provided). Submitted as multipart/form-data: use repeated fields (spiritual_gift[]=1&spiritual_gift[]=3), a single JSON-encoded string (e.g. "[1,3]"), a comma-separated string (e.g. "1,3"), or a bare single ID (e.g. spiritual_gift=1).

employed.description: Submitted as multipart/form-data as the literal string "true" or "false" (also accepts "1"/"0").

occupation.description: IDs of occupations selected. Submitted as multipart/form-data: use repeated fields (occupation[]=2), a single JSON-encoded string (e.g. "[2]"), a comma-separated string (e.g. "2,4"), or a bare single ID (e.g. occupation=2).

education.description: Education levels selected, each paired with its own faculty IDs. This is an array of objects, which cannot be expressed as a plain multipart/form-data field — submit it as a single JSON-encoded string, e.g. [{"education_id":3,"faculty":[4,5]}].

department.description: Departments selected, each paired with its own church responsibility IDs. This is an array of objects, which cannot be expressed as a plain multipart/form-data field — submit it as a single JSON-encoded string, e.g. [{"department_id":1,"church_responsibility":[1,2]}].

picture.description: Image file (jpeg, jpg, png, webp), max 2MB
